author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
We're back with The Indie Hour Episode Sixty-Two! This series focuses on games you may have never even heard of and gives us an inside look at the wider world of independantly published Tabletop Wargames of all genres.

OASIS is a new 6mm Tactical Extraction wargame of exhausted Corporate serfs scrounging for the goods on planets bled white of their resources. Battle other scoungers in this tactical combat game of greed writ-large on a galactic scale. Let's check it out!

Check out the details HERE: https://www.oasiswargame.com/
title: The GMG Indie Hour Ep 062 - OASIS by DRD & Collins Epic Wargames
